statements.statement: Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered for this patient
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable (CO-97)
The service is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
This monitoring is a distinct service from any other covered procedure
The service is medically necessary to identify the underlying cause of the patient's symptoms
